findings.title: Inheritance is assigned through guarded servanthood
findings.claim: The Garden is made legible as an inheritance granted from the divine servant domain to those marked by God-directed self-protection, so the operative distinction is guarded conduct rather than lineage.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb at 19:63:4:1 carries the act of making someone an heir; the servant phrase at 19:63:6:1 supplies the selected domain; and the qualifying form at 19:63:9:1 supplies the protective conduct that filters the recipients. Wider exact formulations repeat Garden inheritance with conduct at 43:72 and 7:43, inheritance from the servant domain at 35:32, and the piety marker at 19:13 and 13:35, returning the wider pattern through the focus relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus becomes more than a destination promise: its grammar presents a transfer, names the community from which recipients are drawn, and places guarded conduct at the point of admission, while the wider parallels make that relation recur beyond this single wording.
findings.containment: This supplements the ordinary reading that Allah grants the Garden to pious servants. It does not turn the Garden into ordinary legal property, reduce servanthood to a human ownership transaction, or claim that every occurrence of these roots activates these branches. The inheritance-transfer and guarded-conduct facets remain jointly available within the supplied evidence.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication directly anchors all three focus branches, and the cited wider rows provide exact target Arabic and explicit relation notes; those target rows do not supply full target morphology, so the global extension is retained with that qualification visible.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimse, başka birinin bir şeyi miras edinmesini sağlar veya o şeyi ona miras bırakır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus form at 19:63:4:1 carries the causative act of making the Garden an inherited possession.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact wider wording at 43:72 calls the Garden an inheritance and links receipt to human deeds, while 7:43 repeats the same inherited-Garden formulation.
branch_activations.activation: The wider parallels return through the focus inheritance verb and make its estate-transfer sense concrete in the Garden relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Garden is read as something assigned to heirs through a transfer relation, not merely as a place named as a reward.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not assert ordinary family succession or import the full legal structure of human inheritance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimsenin emek harcamadan hoş bir şeye kavuşması, miras edinme biçiminde anlatılabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus inheritance form presents the divine act as the source of the recipients' possession.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus qualifier marks the God-conscious recipients, and the exact wider wording at 13:35 joins the promised Garden to the pious.
branch_activations.activation: The recipient criterion meets the inheritance form, so the Garden's receipt is perceptible as an assigned good whose acquisition is described through inheritance rather than prior labor.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The phrase carries an unearned-acquisition facet alongside its ordinary Garden promise.
branch_activations.boundary: The evidence does not quantify merit, deny all human action, or generalize this facet to every gift.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi özgürün karşıtı olarak bir başkasının mülkiyetinde bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural servant expression carries a belonging-to-God facet for the people from whom heirs are selected.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus inheritance act selects from that servant domain, and 35:32 supplies an exact wider inheritance-plus-servants formulation.
branch_activations.activation: The inheritance relation makes the servant noun's belonging dimension contact the transfer act, while the wider formulation shows the servant domain recurring with divine inheritance language.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recipients are framed within a divine servant domain before the piety condition differentiates them.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the supplied belonging facet without claiming a human property transaction or making this the only meaning of servant language.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korkulan şeyden ya da yanlış davranıştan kendini koruma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, korkulan ya da zarar verecek şey ile kendi arasına koruyucu bir önlem koyar.
branch_activations.carrier: The final qualifying adjective carries the person's active self-protective posture.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus inheritance act uses this quality as its recipient filter, and 19:13 repeats the same piety marker in the wider surah.
branch_activations.activation: The criterion is attached to the inheritance relation, so self-protection becomes the operative disposition of the people who receive the Garden.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Piety is perceptible as an active protective stance, not only as a static label applied to the recipients.
branch_activations.boundary: The packet does not specify one exhaustive list of protected acts or collapse piety into a single behavior.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korkulan şeyden ya da yanlış davranıştan kendini koruma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma, kişi ile sakınılan sonuç arasına koruyucu bir tutum koymak olarak düşünülür.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus adjective names a person whose God-directed conduct places a guard between the person and the forbidden consequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The inheritance relation identifies this guarded disposition as the qualifying condition, and 13:35 supplies a wider Garden-and-piety pairing.
branch_activations.activation: The wider piety-and-Garden pairing returns through the focus qualifier and clarifies the protective orientation of the condition attached to inheritance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The Garden's inheritance is tied to a God-directed protective posture within the focus's servant group.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed semantic relation, not a claim that the supplied wider rows resolve every theological or legal detail of taqwa.
